Prepare concrete engineer-facing platform entrypoints and documentation in a private overlay. You own only /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/platform-entrypoints-e409. Do not touch maintained sources, the contest Git working tree, serial/boards/USBIP/Windows networking, AI conversation logs, or publish. Do not spawn other workers. Root and two workers are handling exact hardware and factory digit integration.
Read the existing offline layout review at /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/platform-layout-review-e406. It identified stale public build.sh, a 14-project versus 36-project source closure, and missing portable developer entrypoints. Implement—not only propose—private candidate files for the public contest repository with canonical openvela source layers. Preserve required top-level board/ and logs/ layout. Use current /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/tools/build-support/environment.py, restore_product.py, offline_sdk.py, verify_sdk.py and tools/tests/korvo-adc-keys/build.py. The verified standalone factory product is /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/korvo-factory-product-e403; receiver /mnt/wsl/s31-factory-receiver-e403/workspace. Inspect exact manifests/dependencies.
Deliver candidate files/<contest-repo-relative-path>: root README, clear workspace/REPRODUCE.md, workspace/profiles.json, portable workspace/build.sh or build.py that invokes the actual source-layout-supported build helper and fresh output, workspace/restore-offline.py wrapper if warranted, board/source-map or developer layer docs. The restored layout contract is platform-root/openvela-dev/{nuttx,apps,frameworks,...}, sibling tools and s31-reference. No hard-coded /home/regex or D-drive paths in shipped files. Existing thin snapshot uses flattened checkout; explicitly explain/wrap its mapping and don't falsely call untested replay equivalent to verified offline export. Inspect but do not modify current contest apply-snapshot tools. Preserve licences and canonical board source directories. Do not restructure raw evidence or logs; Root will do that.
Supported headline profiles are korvo-openvela-factory (FLAT singlecore, native AM/PM/WM/MEDIA, camera/touch/display/SD/USB Host/ADC keys; WiFi and BLE disabled), function-ethernet (FLAT singlecore EMAC, basic link/ping/TCP/UDP board accepted; no throughput claim), and existing documented network/basic profiles only if verified in local records. Keep build-tested versus board-tested distinct. Factory digit one-image integration is pending under factory-digit-integration-e407; documentation should provide the intended main -> digit -> return flow without claiming it already passed. Original independent dualcore digit is optional legacy demonstration, not the required final UI.
Do not create a new complex flashing engine; root will reuse reviewed transaction helpers. If a flash front door is feasible, provide artifact verification and an explicit manual esptool guide only with layout derivation and full original backup/restore, never hardcoded MACs or automatic board writes. Check whether current standalone manifest actually carries enough metadata. No downloads, no long builds while two candidates compile. Test only meaningful path validation, wrapper dry-run, registry consistency and offline rejection cases; deliver changed-file/base hashes, a patch and readiness report with limits. Avoid wholesale cleanup; focus on a usable engineer front door. Read no massive event logs. Preserve current user's edits.
我会先核对离线布局审查、现有构建/恢复工具和已验证产品清单，再在指定私有目录内实现可移植入口与文档，并做轻量验证。所有输出仅写入该 overlay；不操作硬件、维护源码或 contest 工作树。
已确认两条复现路径不能混称：E403 离线导出有独立接收端构建记录，当前公开薄快照仍只有 14 个变更项目，候选快照是 36 个。新入口会明确采用 `openvela-dev/` 布局，并分别记录构建验证与实板验收；factory 的主界面 → 数字识别 → 返回流程将标为待集成验证。
现有构建 helper 与 E403 接收端的六个关键工具文件逐字节一致，可以直接复用。factory manifest 已有镜像哈希、16 MiB 容量、`0x2000` 偏移和无 AppFS 标记，但缺少完整板卡事务信息；我会提供只读产物核验及人工备份/烧录/恢复指南，不实现自动刷板。
入口和配置登记表已写入私有 `files/`：构建包装器检查标准目录、依赖锁、配置 include 闭包和全新输出路径，再调用真实 helper。E403 缺少 `function-ethernet` 时会明确拒绝；文档也已标明，旧 apply 工具应以 `platform-root/openvela-dev` 为回放根目录。接下来验证空格路径、dry-run 和离线拒绝行为。
真实 E403 接收端的构建 dry-run 和 factory 产物核验已通过。测试也确认交付盘目录不区分大小写，源码恢复器会在写入源码前拒绝；文档已要求把源码恢复到区分大小写的文件系统。接下来补完拒绝用例，并生成可核对基线的补丁和就绪报告。
轻量验证已完成：90 项断言通过，涵盖真实接收端 dry-run、路径与输出冲突、缺包/坏包拒绝、离线拦截器及 factory 产物核验。22 个候选文件的补丁也已在私有副本中检查并回放，结果与 `files/` 逐字节一致；未启动构建或硬件操作。

Implemented 22 candidate files in the private overlay, including portable build/restore entrypoints, profile registry, source mapping, artifact verification and documentation.

All 90 lightweight checks passed; private patch replay matched every candidate file. No maintained/contest edits, downloads, builds, hardware operations or publication occurred.

Full source closure, Ethernet integration and factory digit qualification remain explicitly pending.
